entities.name: Piperidine diamine
observations: Search interpretation: 1-(4-piperidin-4-ylbutyl)piperidine; one piperidine nitrogen is secondary and nucleophilic, while the other is tertiary and not acylated under ordinary conditions.

entities.name: Heteroaromatic acid chloride
observations: Search interpretation: methyl-substituted thieno-fused benzodiazepine carbonyl chloride containing a reactive C(O)Cl group.

entities.name: Acid chloride aminolysis
observations: The acid chloride carbonyl undergoes nucleophilic acyl substitution with the secondary piperidine NH, replacing Cl with the piperidinyl nitrogen and forming an amide.

entities.name: Ethyl acetate
observations: Interpreted as a solvent or inert additive; not incorporated into the principal product.
